URL: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ckg4xj8j5vjo
NOTE: BBC — "Inflation falls slightly to 2.6%" (22 Jul 2026, 06:07). CPI 2.6% in year to June, down from 2.8% May, driven by lower fuel prices; food prices fell (chocolate, beef, margarine). ONS chief economist Grant Fitzner: "A fall in motor fuel prices, particularly diesel, helped ease inflation in June."
